description_short: List all rare-earth ALD processes in comparison R1471077 that achieve high growth per cycle (GPC ≥ 1 Å) at low deposition temperature (≤ 250 °C), returning material, precursor family, co-reactant, GPC, and temperature.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

postprocessing_notes.normalization: GPC and temperature are parsed from textual fields by extracting the first numeric token (handling ranges and punctuation) and casting to xsd:decimal.
postprocessing_notes.derived_features: The 'family' column is derived from the metal precursor label (P180042) using substring rules to group ligands into Cp-derived, amidinate, formamidinate, guanidinate, β-diketonate, alkoxide/amide, and 'other'.
postprocessing_notes.filters: Only records with GPC ≥ 1.0 Å/cycle and deposition temperature ≤ 250 °C are retained.
postprocessing_notes.aggregation: No aggregation beyond filtering; each row corresponds to a single ALD process entry in the comparison.
